title: TGSRTC Employees Protest in Khammam Following Conductor's Death

tea.why: TGSRTC employees protested following the death of a young bus conductor who succumbed to injuries after being pushed from a moving bus.
tea.want: Protesters demanded stringent legal punishment for the accused and foolproof safety measures for drivers and conductors.
tea.changed: Nov 4: TGSRTC employees boycotted duties and staged demonstrations across seven depots in the Khammam region.

summary: Transport corporation employees staged demonstrations and boycotted duties across seven depots in the erstwhile Khammam district following the death of a 24-year-old TGSRTC conductor. The employee union, TGSRTC Khammam Region JAC, led the protests wearing black badges and paying homage at the Khammam bus depot. The conductor had succumbed to injuries on Tuesday night after battling for life for nearly ten days, following an incident where she was allegedly pushed from a moving bus by a woman passenger over a ticket dispute. Protesters demanded severe punishment for the accused and guaranteed safety measures for transport workers. In response, Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar and the TGSRTC Managing Director visited the hospital mortuary, while the government announced financial compensation, accident insurance, and a compassionate job for the deceased conductor's family.
demands: Foolproof safety measures for drivers and conductors
response: Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar and the TGSRTC MD paid respects at the mortuary, announcing an ex-gratia of Rs. 10 lakh, a government job for the mother, an Indiramma house, and Rs. 1 crore in accident insurance compensation. Police stated the accused was arrested and the case altered to murder.

arrests.text: Police had already arrested the accused, identified as Mounika of Mittagudem

deaths.text: succumbed to her injuries on Tuesday (November 3, 2026) night after battling for life for nearly 10 days

updates.text: TGSRTC employees boycotted duties and halted bus services across seven depots in the Khammam district.
